subject: Air freight quote request – Bonn to SGN
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN), including truck pickup from our site in 53088 (Bonn), Germany? Please arrange the truck to the departure airport. The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28.

The cargo is electronic control units, packed in 5 pieces, with a gross weight of 1403 kg and a total volume of 13.44 cbm.

Please send us your all-in price in EUR and confirm the earliest possible pickup and arrival at SGN.

Thank you.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
